suggested_caption: MorphoNup computational graph (B = batch). Each sequence is presented as its forward and reverse-complement view; the same network scores both and the probabilities are averaged. 134,442 parameters, 129,743 trainable. All normalization statistics, PLS rotations and motif prototypes are fitted on the fit rows of each outer fold.

From 14 DNAshape tracks to the 9 shape channels MorphoNup uses. Buckle, Shear, Shift and Tilt change sign on the reverse strand, so with both strands pooled their pointwise covariance with the label is zero and PLS gives them zero weight.

Evaluation protocol of every MorphoNup result: outer k-fold cross-validation with a tuning split inside each training fold, base run for checkpoint selection, refit on fit + tune rows, pooled out-of-fold metrics per seed and mean ± SD over three seeds.
